host.approvalOverride: approve (harness process only; user configuration unchanged)

negativeRuns.boundedRemediation: Remove the per-run hard-coded args override; the unchanged managed user registration then resumes cwd-relative launch.

environmentObservations.diagnosis: The first campaign used repositories Codex had not yet trusted. Codex persisted its own project trust records, so the config sentinel halted the harness before it emitted a receipt.
environmentObservations.disposition: The green campaign reused the preregistered repositories only after Codex trust existed, reset their temporary Amanuensis stores, and retained every run independently. The untrusted attempt is not pooled into the trusted-repository claim.

unsupportedStrata: Codex desktop task UI (this campaign measured the Codex CLI exec host surface)
published npm registry installation (publication was not authorized)
repositories before the Codex host trust prerequisite is satisfied
exclusions: No failed positive runs were excluded or pooled.
The negative control is reported separately and does not contribute to the positive denominator.
